name: Kyou Kara Idol ~Imitation Doll~
original_name: 今日からアイドル ～IMITATION DOLL～
source:
Main character's elder sister who works as an idol suddenly disappears. Her brother who has the same appearance takes her place under pressure of their mother and idol manager at the same time. Main character welcomes getting to know other idols closely, but where is his sister?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的姐姐是一名偶像，却突然失踪。弟弟与她长得一模一样，在母亲和偶像经纪人双重压力下，只得代替姐姐登上舞台。主人公很高兴能近距离结识其他偶像，可他的姐姐究竟去了哪里？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vndb-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
